capabilities: Turn pages by dragging a corner, tapping the edge or arrow keys
Draw on pages with pen, highlighter and eraser
Save text highlights as links in a book note
Stick notes and index cards on pages
Search a book and browse its contents and marks
extras: No network use, no account and nothing to pay for; book files are only read. Needs Obsidian 1.13 or later. DRM EPUBs and fixed-layout EPUBs are not supported, scanned PDFs have no selectable text, and .desk files need 'Sync all other types' enabled in Obsidian Sync.
problem: Obsidian can show a PDF but gives no book-like reading with page turning, ink annotation and highlights that are kept in your own notes.

relations.evidence: The links use the format of PDF++, so both plugins show the same highlights.
If Excalidraw is installed, its scripting interface is used to put a desk on a drawing.

summary: Reads PDF and EPUB books as pages on a desk, with pen, highlighter, sticky notes, index cards and highlights saved as links in your notes.
